selected_problem: Frank admits productive limit cycles/metastability and already has trajectory-regime/utility/overcoupling controls, but local trajectory or per-loop stability readouts do not establish orbital stability of the composed loop-of-loops recurrence.
synthetic_meaning: Constructed counterexamples prove local scalar/Jacobian labels are not logically sufficient for composed periodic stability and show a neutral phase mode can hurt noisy full-return estimation. They do not estimate real Frank prevalence, threshold, cost or quality.
prior_art_result: Broad novelty destroyed by Poincare/Floquet periodic-orbit stability, transverse contraction, hybrid limit-cycle stability and network small-gain theory.

strongest_counterhypothesis.statement: Use conventional Poincare/Floquet/transverse-contraction or small-gain diagnostics as ordinary Harness evidence consumed by the existing Frank loop controller, with no new runtime object.
strongest_counterhypothesis.remaining_question: whether one typed RecurrenceStabilityEnvelope materially improves stale-evidence rejection, replay reproducibility, calibration or lesion localization on real Frank

retained_candidate: A revocable typed diagnostic envelope bound to exact cycle/state epoch, reference phase, perturbation basis, estimator, baseline and uncertainty; diagnostic only and deletable if an ordinary receipt bundle matches it.

prior_atomic_relations.CQC: orthogonal; quotienting may later protect loop-regime/transverse-stability behavior as an observable
prior_atomic_relations.DCA: orthogonal bounded-context completeness candidate; no shared runtime object

required_next_real_test: Matched accepted-target replay after a bounded real loop component and Original Baseline exist: scalar trajectory controller vs local-Jacobian heuristic vs conventional full-return/Poincare/Floquet diagnostic vs phase-aligned transverse typed receipt under benign phase drift, state perturbation, cross-loop gain perturbation, GWT corruption, re-entry-delay change, restart/recovery and OOD episodes.
kill_rule: If the conventional diagnostic carried in existing typed receipts matches defect detection, calibration, lesion localization, stale-evidence rejection and replay reproducibility with lower complexity, delete the TRSE named object and retain only the test law.
